title: At every turn: Meaning and Examples — Word Power 52
content:
## At every turn

**Word Power 52 · English idioms**

### Meaning

Always and everywhere.

### Usage

1. M. C. Mary Com finally managed to achieve her goal, although she had met with opposition at every turn.
2. They did their best to frustrate my efforts at every turn.

### How to use it

At every turn means repeatedly or at many stages of an experience. It often accompanies encounter, face or meet. It can describe persistent help or repeated difficulties, depending on the context.

### Another example

At every turn, the new volunteer found somebody willing to explain the work.

### Check your understanding

Complete: The project faced delays at every ___. (turn / turning)

### Suggested answer

Turn. Keep the singular noun after every. The expression describes repeated obstacles at different stages.
